citation: Motteram, G., Choudry, S., Kalambouka, A., Hutcheson, G., & Barton, A. (2016). ReflectED: Evaluation report and executive summary. London: Education Endowment Foundation.
report_number: EEF project: ReflectED (Metacognition) efficacy trial, University of Manchester evaluation, November 2016; trial registration ISRCTN41017069; ERIC ED581262
design: Cluster RCT, school-based with class-level randomisation (assignment = Teacher/Class). 30 schools, 70 Year 5 classes randomised (38 intervention / 32 control), 1858 pupils (997 intervention / 861 control). Subjects: maths (primary) and reading (secondary) via CEM InCAS computer-adaptive standardised tests; Year 5 (England, ~age 9-10, grade 3-6 band). Efficacy trial vs business-as-usual control; immediate post-test June 2015 (~1 academic year after start). Two-level multilevel model (pupils nested in classes), value-added, controlling for KS1 prior attainment and FSM.
problems: Two analysis variants are reported throughout (complete-case and multiple-imputation/ITT). The EEF Executive Summary Table 1 (the padlock-rated headline figures) reports the COMPLETE-CASE estimates: maths g=0.30 (-0.04,0.63) and reading g=-0.15 (-0.59,0.29). I record these complete-case estimates as the headline g, matching the exec-summary and the value most likely used by the meta-analysis, and record the imputed ITT alternates in notes (maths g=0.27, SE=0.19; reading g=-0.05, SE=0.228). The report explicitly computes 'Hedges G' as a standardised MLM coefficient (response variable standardised by pooled SD: maths SD=21.24, reading SD=15.46, Table 11), so impact_estimate IS g directly; g_se taken from the MLM coefficient SE (Appendix 2 Table 13 / Appendix 3 Table 15), and g_var=SE^2. SEs reproduce the reported 95% CIs exactly. The report does not state explicit application of the J small-sample correction, but labels the estimates Hedges' G and EEF convention treats them as g. ICC reported per outcome (raw and prior-attainment-adjusted, Table 12); cluster_adjusted=true because the impact estimate + SE come from the two-level MLM. Note raw unadjusted posttest diff is near zero for maths (d~-0.01); the positive 0.30 is driven by the value-added pretest adjustment (control group had marginally higher prior attainment). 18% incomplete cases (above EEF 5% threshold) cost one security padlock. FSM-only maths subgroup also extracted (is_full_sample=false). Attitude-to-maths and attitude-to-reading outcomes are attitudinal, not academic achievement, so not extracted per spec.

effect_sizes.arm_label: ReflectED metacognition (single TPD arm: Rosendale-trained Year 5 teachers) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.timepoint: post (June 2015, end of ~1 academic year intervention)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's own Hedges' G = standardised ReflectED coefficient from two-level MLM (pupils in classes), value-added controlling for KS1 maths + FSM; response standardised by pooled SD=21.24 (Table 11). Taken directly as g (complete-case model, Appendix 2 Table 13: beta=0.30, SE=0.17). g_var=SE^2. SE reproduces reported 95% CI (-0.04,0.63).
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.5 Table 1 (exec summary); p.21 Table 6 (complete cases); p.46 Appendix 2 Table 13 (MLM coefficient & SE)
effect_sizes.notes: Maths -> STEM per spec. Primary/headline outcome; complete-case estimate = EEF exec-summary padlock figure (4 months' progress). Imputed ITT alternate: g=0.27, SE=0.19, 95% CI (-0.1,0.63), n in model 1858 (997;861), p=0.16; complete-case p=0.08. ICC: raw 0.28, prior-attainment-adjusted 0.34 (Table 12). n_clusters=65 (35 int + 30 ctrl classes analysed, complete cases); full randomised design 70 classes. Raw posttest means (95% CI) int 96.87 (95.51,98.33), ctrl 97.10 (95.52,98.68); pupil-level SDs not separately tabulated (pooled SD 21.24 given).
